headline: Landslip in Lahaul and Spiti, Met predicts wet spell in Himachal Pradesh from May 28
content: Shimla The Sansari-Killar-Therot-Tandi (SKTT) road was blocked for vehicular traffic following a massive landslip in Lahaul and Spiti district in Himachal Pradesh, officials said. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/himachal-pradesh/ Meanwhile, the weather office said that parts of the State was under the grip of a heatwave with dry weather on Wednesday (May 28, 2026) but it could soon change with a wet spell likely in the coming days. Deputy Commissioner (DC) Kiran Bhadana, who visited the landslip site at Jahalma Nullah, said efforts are under way to open the road at the earliest. https://www.thehindu.com/tag/heatwave/ Indian Army, IAF contain major forest fire in Himachal’s Kasauli slopes Indian Army, IAF contain major forest fire in Himachal’s Kasauli slopes The combined operation stretched over 15 hours through the night and into the following day; no loss of life or injuries reported; operations are continuing over inaccessible stretches Indian Army, IAF contain major forest fire in Himachal’s Kasauli slopes storyline 1 With the panchayat election process currently underway in the district, officials said ensuring the timely transportation of polling parties, election personnel and ballot boxes to their respective destinations remains one of the administration's top priorities. Major Paras Kocher, Officer Commanding (OC) of the Border Road Organisation’s 94 Road Construction Companies (BRO's 94 RCC) said work on constructing an alternative route to restore connectivity for light motor vehicles is proceeding on a war footing and the route would be opened for light vehicles by Thursday (May 28, 2026). Heatwave was witnessed in isolated places in six districts — Una, Bilaspur, Hamirpur, Kangra, Mandi and Solan. 2025 landslide in Shimla Act of God, NHAI tells NGT, rejects compensation claim 2025 landslide in Shimla Act of God, NHAI tells NGT, rejects compensation claim NHAI submitted its reply against plea filed in January, claiming that heavy construction work being undertaken by the authority and its concessionaire, without properly strengthening a slope, had damaged agricultural land in Shimla rural tehsil, causing landslides 2025 landslide in Shimla Act of God, NHAI tells NGT, rejects compensation claim storyline 1 Meanwhile, the Shimla Met office issued an orange warning for hail, thunderstorm, lightning and gusty winds (speed 40-60 kmph) at isolated places in five districts — Chamba, Kangra, Kullu, Mandi and Shimla — on May 28 (Thursday) and for Kangra, Kullu, Mandi, Shimla and Sirmaur on May 29 (Friday). It also predicted a wet spell in Himachal Pradesh from May 28 to June 2 as a fresh Western Disturbance is likely to affect northwest India. On Wednesday (May 27, 2026), Kukumseri was the coldest at night in Himachal, recording a low of 4.6°C while night temperatures rose to 19°C and 18.8°C in the tourist resorts of Shimla and Dharamshala, respectively. Una was the hottest during the day with a high of 44°C followed by Neri at 40.7°C, Sundernagar at 39.3°C, Berthin at 39°C, Kangra at 38.8°C and Mandi at 38.6°C.
